ssl_insecure.description: Use SSL connection without verifying certificate.

quiet.description: Disable logging to stderr. Does not affect --verbose or --debug-file or logging to syslog.

verbose.description: Verbose mode. Multiple -v flags can be stacked on the command line.

verbose_level.description: Level of debugging detail in output. Defaults to the number of --verbose flags specified on the command line, or to 1 if verbose=1.

debug_file.description: Write debug information to given file Obsoletes: debug.

plug_separator.description: Separator for plug parameter when specifying more than 1 plug.

separator.description: Separator for CSV created by 'list' operation.

delay.description: Wait X seconds before fencing is started.

disable_timeout.description: Disable timeout (true/false) (default: true when run from Pacemaker 2.0+).

login_timeout.description: Wait X seconds for cmd prompt after login.

power_timeout.description: Test X seconds for status change after ON/OFF.

power_wait.description: Wait X seconds after issuing ON/OFF.

shell_timeout.description: Wait X seconds for cmd prompt after issuing command.

stonith_status_sleep.description: Sleep X seconds between status calls during a STONITH action.

retry_on.description: Count of attempts to retry power on.
